title: Cache-aside: the first read pays for the miss, the next ones are hits
caption: The application owns the logic: look in the cache, fall back to the database, then fill the cache with a TTL.

messages.label: GET user:42
messages.note: First request for this user: the cache has never seen the key.

messages.label: SELECT … WHERE id = 42
messages.note: Only now does the database do any work: about 20 ms.

messages.label: SET user:42 row EX 300
messages.note: Store the copy with a 5-minute TTL so a missed invalidation can't live forever.

messages.label: GET user:42 (next request)
messages.note: Every later read within the TTL is a ~0.5 ms hit, and the database is untouched.
